name: writing-loop
description: An autonomous short-drama (竖屏短剧) writers' room in a folder. Ten agents screen adaptation sources, plan, design, write, review, score, and market-watch scripts through ticket state; a North Star charter plus canonical structured story design/assets keep serials coherent without duplicate Markdown mirrors. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.

interface.longDescription: Ten agents (Showrunner, Source-Analyst, Story-Designer, Episode-Writer, Reviewer, Script-Doctor, Evaluator, Market-Watch, Reflect, Sweep) screen sources, plan, design, write, review, and score vertical micro-drama (竖屏短剧) scripts through ticket state on a local file board. The North Star is the creative charter; canonical structured story design/assets are the reusable structure and story-fact sources. Studio renders these facts directly instead of maintaining duplicate Markdown mirrors.
